headline: No. 14 Georgia Travels to No. 6 Notre Dame
subhead: Bulldogs seek first win against surging Irish at home

xFactor.why: Jadarian Price ranks eighth in the PCFL with 102 rushing yards and a touchdown

keyMatchup: Georgia's passing attack averaging 191.5 yards per game against a Notre Dame defense yielding 418.5 total yards per game
body: Georgia arrives at 0-2 after dropping a 42-28 decision to Colorado, leaving the Bulldogs 14th in the power poll and last in the Eastern Southern at 0-1 on the road. The offense averages 21 points and 291.5 yards per game, ranking 18th in the league, with 191.5 passing yards and 100 rushing yards per contest, while the defense surrenders 39.5 points and 472 yards per game, 17th overall.

Notre Dame sits 1-1 and sixth in the power poll following a 35-10 win over Arkansas, holding a 1-0 home mark in the Western Central. The Irish offense produces 28 points and 385 yards per game, 11th in the PCFL, splitting 247.5 passing yards and 137.5 rushing yards, and the defense allows 33 points and 418.5 yards per game, 14th in the league. Running back Jadarian Price paces the ground game with 102 yards and a touchdown, good for eighth in the PCFL.
